description: Line 549 uses strict equality (b_ava.oid == a_ava.oid) while normalizing only the attribute values. This is the correct boundary: OIDs are fixed-form identifiers with no semantic equivalence across different DER encodings. Prevents a subtle class of bugs where someone might try to normalize OIDs or treat different encodings as equivalent. The pattern reinforces the principle: attribute types (OIDs) are structural identifiers; attribute values are content subject to normalization rules (RFC 4518).
title: Decision: Strict OID identity for AVA matching
